title: Assemble the normalized natural module restriction iso
statement: Fix a prime l, a normalized family of base comparisons [lem-sf-adic-module-section-data], and a family c of ring-sheaf isomorphisms on all site objects that is the identity on each further-object function. There is a natural iso from native adic pullback followed by the target base equivalence to the base equivalence followed by literal module restriction through c. Its component on every local section is the actual inverse-image/localization section map conjugated by the base additive section identifications. These are only module restriction conclusions, with no tensor, Hom, evaluation or bidual compatibility asserted.

source.place: Sections Localization of ringed sites, Tensor product and Internal Hom; definition-localize-ringed-site, lemma-tensor-product-pullback, lemma-internal-hom-restriction and lemma-internal-hom-adjoint-tensor. Specialization and normalization steps of lem-sf-adic-module-slice-compatibility; the native constructions in lean/WeilConjectures/CategoryTheory/Monoidal/Mod/Evaluation.lean and lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/ProEtale/Adic/InternalHomEvaluation.lean.

proof.text: Use [lem-sf-adic-slice-restriction-linear] to turn the explicit additive section equivalence into a linear equivalence at each object. The base section_restriction equations and naturality of the actual localization comparison prove site-object naturality. Lift the resulting presheaf-module iso to a sheaf-module iso. The base section_map equations and the naturality of the localization comparison in modules make these isomorphisms natural in modules. Cancellation of the additive section equivalence gives the prescribed section formula.

proof_origin.place: Explicit refinement of the corresponding action, pure-tensor or transpose step of lem-sf-adic-module-slice-compatibility; the Lean assembly uses the existing native and base normalization APIs.

theorem adicSliceRestrictionComparison (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (base : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, AdicModuleSectionComparison l X)
    (c : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt),
      (base U.left).ring ≅
        (localizationRestriction RingCat.{u + 1} U.hom U.prop).obj (base X).ring)
    (hc : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.ProEt) (V : U.left.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (a : (base U.left).ring.obj.obj V), HEq (((c X U).hom.hom.app V) a) a) :
    Nonempty (AdicSliceRestrictionData l base c)
